prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- sign_in: 84.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Style Preview Gallery Screen: Add a dedicated pet style preview gallery screen right after pick_friend so users can review visual variants before custom photo uploads. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 63.2% with a long median time of 89s, and 3 support emails cite custom pet visual generation issues.)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Creation Progress Tracker: Display explicit stage progress breakdown and remaining time estimates during pet generation on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step (home target step) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user churn before home completion.)
2: [home, notification] Background Notification Opt-In Prompt: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes while working in other apps. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), leading to users abandoning the app while waiting in the background.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path Guidance Hint on Story Screen: Add a prominent path selection hint on the story screen to prime users before entering path selection. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and drop-off rate of 23.8%, indicating users need context before making decisions.)

scores.note: High drop-off (36.8%) backed by both funnel and support emails, but adding a new screen carries high implementation cost.
Extremely long wait times (mean 2336s) make progress tracking a proven, high-confidence UX fix.
Addresses background abandonment during long render times, though opt-in rates may vary.
Helps set expectations for initial path choice to reduce high mean duration (514s).
